method.description: Lexical/rendering divergence indicator; not a doctrinal truth score or majority vote.
method.normalization: case, punctuation, footnote markers, and common KJV archaisms normalized
method.public_ranking_guard: minimum 8 POB tokens and three length-compatible references
method.public_headline: POB novelty × square-root(reference consensus); documented risk is excluded

sources.bsb: Berean Standard Bible (Public Domain / CC0). bereanbible.com.
sources.asv: American Standard Version (1901; Public Domain). ebible.org/asv/.

pob.text: Jude[a], a slave of Jesus the Messiah and brother of James, to those who are loved in God the Father and kept for Jesus the Messiah[c][b], called:

spob.text: This letter is from Jude, a slave of Jesus the Messiah and a brother of James. I am writing to those who have been called, who are loved in God the Father,[a] and who are kept for Jesus the Messiah.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who are called, loved by God the Father, and kept in Jesus Christ:
public_domain_references.web: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
public_domain_references.asv: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are called, beloved in God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
public_domain_references.kjv: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, [and] called:

pob.text: May mercy and peace and love be multiplied to you[a].

spob.text: May mercy and peace and love come to you in greater and greater measure.

public_domain_references.bsb: Mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
public_domain_references.web: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
public_domain_references.asv: Mercy unto you and peace and love be multiplied.
public_domain_references.kjv: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

pob.text: Beloved[a], although I was making every effort to write to you about our common salvation, I found it necessary to write[d][c][b], urging you to contend earnestly for the faith once for all delivered to the saints.

spob.text: Beloved, I was very eager to write to you about the salvation we share. But instead, I had to write to urge you to struggle earnestly for the faith—the Christian teaching handed down once for all to God’s holy people.

public_domain_references.bsb: Beloved, although I made every effort to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt it necessary to write and urge you to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.
public_domain_references.web: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.
public_domain_references.asv: Beloved, while I was giving all diligence to write unto you of our common salvation, I was constrained to write unto you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered unto the saints.
public_domain_references.kjv: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort [you] that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.

pob.text: For certain men have slipped in unnoticed[a], who long ago were designated for this judgment, ungodly men who turn the grace of our God into sensuality and deny our only Master and Lord[d][c][b], Jesus the Messiah.

spob.text: Some men have slipped in unnoticed. Long ago, they were designated for this judgment.[a] They are ungodly men who use the grace of our God to justify shameless self-indulgence. They also deny Jesus the Messiah, our only Master and Lord.

public_domain_references.bsb: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation. They turn the grace of our God into a license for immorality, and they deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.web: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.asv: For there are certain men crept in privily, [even] they who were of old written of beforehand unto this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.kjv: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

pob.text: I want to remind you[a], though you know all things once for all, that Jesus, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who did not believe.

spob.text: I want to remind you of what you already know once for all: Jesus[a] saved a people from the land of Egypt. Later, he destroyed those who did not believe.

public_domain_references.bsb: Although you are fully aware of this, I want to remind you that after Jesus had delivered His people out of the land of Egypt, He destroyed those who did not believe.
public_domain_references.web: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.
public_domain_references.asv: Now I desire to put you in remembrance, though ye know all things once for all, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
public_domain_references.kjv: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.

pob.text: And the angels who did not keep their own domain[a], but abandoned their proper dwelling[c][b], he has kept in eternal chains under gloom for the judgment of the great day.

spob.text: And the angels who did not keep to the place assigned to them[a], but abandoned the dwelling meant for them—he has kept them chained forever in deep gloom for judgment on the great day.

public_domain_references.bsb: And the angels who did not stay within their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling—these He has kept in eternal chains under darkness, bound for judgment on that great day.
public_domain_references.web: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.
public_domain_references.asv: And angels that kept not their own principality, but left their proper habitation, he hath kept in everlasting bonds under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

pob.text: just as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them[a], having in like manner committed sexual immorality and gone after other flesh, are set forth as an example[b], undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.

spob.text: The same is true of Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them.[a] They committed sexual immorality and pursued other flesh.[b] They stand as a warning to others, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

public_domain_references.bsb: In like manner, Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, who indulged in sexual immorality and pursued strange flesh, are on display as an example of those who sustain the punishment of eternal fire.
public_domain_references.web: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
public_domain_references.asv: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities about them, having in like manner with these given themselves over to fornication and gone after strange flesh, are set forth as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
public_domain_references.kjv: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.

pob.text: Yet in the same way, these people also, relying on dreams, defile the flesh, reject authority, and slander glorious ones.

spob.text: Yet these people follow the same pattern. They rely on dreams to justify what they do: they make the flesh morally unclean, reject authority, and slander glorious ones.[a][b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Yet in the same way these dreamers defile their bodies, reject authority, and slander glorious beings.
public_domain_references.web: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
public_domain_references.asv: Yet in like manner these also in their dreamings defile the flesh, and set at nought dominion, and rail at dignities.
public_domain_references.kjv: Likewise also these [filthy] dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.

pob.text: But Michael the archangel[a], when he was disputing with the devil and arguing about Moses' body, did not dare to bring a slanderous judgment against him, but said[b], “May the Lord rebuke you.”

spob.text: But when Michael the archangel was in a dispute with the devil, arguing over Moses’ body, Michael did not dare to pass a slanderous judgment on the devil.[a] Instead, he said, “May the Lord rebuke you.”[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: But even the archangel Michael, when he disputed with the devil over the body of Moses, did not presume to bring a slanderous charge against him, but said, “The Lord rebuke you!”
public_domain_references.web: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
public_domain_references.asv: But Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing judgment, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

pob.text: But these people slander whatever they do not understand[a], and whatever they understand naturally, like irrational animals[c][b], by these things they are corrupted.

spob.text: But these people slander[a] what they do not understand. What they do understand comes by instinct, like animals that cannot reason. Those very things are destroying them.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: These men, however, slander what they do not understand, and like irrational animals, they will be destroyed by the things they do instinctively.
public_domain_references.web: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
public_domain_references.asv: But these rail at whatsoever things they know not: and what they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason, in these things are they destroyed.
public_domain_references.kjv: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.

pob.text: Woe to them[a], because they have walked in the way of Cain, and have poured themselves out for pay into Balaam’s error, and have perished in Korah’s rebellion.

spob.text: Woe to them! They have followed Cain’s path. For pay, they have rushed headlong into Balaam’s error.[a] They have perished in Korah’s rebellion.

public_domain_references.bsb: Woe to them! They have traveled the path of Cain; they have rushed headlong into the error of Balaam; they have perished in Korah’s rebellion.
public_domain_references.web: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
public_domain_references.asv: Woe unto them! for they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in the gainsaying of Korah.
public_domain_references.kjv: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

pob.text: These are hidden reefs at your love feasts[a], feasting together without fear, shepherding themselves; waterless clouds carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead[c][b], uprooted.

spob.text: These people are hidden reefs at your shared meals of Christian love.[a] They feast with you without fear. They act like shepherds who care only for themselves.[b] They are clouds without water, carried along by winds. They are autumn trees with no fruit—twice dead and uprooted.

public_domain_references.bsb: These men are hidden reefs in your love feasts, shamelessly feasting with you but shepherding only themselves. They are clouds without water, carried along by the wind; fruitless trees in autumn, twice dead after being uprooted.
public_domain_references.web: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
public_domain_references.asv: These are they who are hidden rocks in your love-feasts when they feast with you, shepherds that without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
public_domain_references.kjv: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds [they are] without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

pob.text: wild waves of the sea[a], foaming up their own shames; wandering stars[b], for whom the gloom of darkness has been reserved forever.

spob.text: They are wild sea waves, foaming up their own shame.[a] They are wandering stars. Deep, gloomy darkness has been kept for them forever.

public_domain_references.bsb: They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.
public_domain_references.web: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
public_domain_references.asv: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness hath been reserved for ever.
public_domain_references.kjv: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.

pob.text: And Enoch[a], the seventh from Adam, also prophesied to these, saying, “Behold[c][b], the Lord came with his holy myriads,”

spob.text: Enoch, the seventh in line from Adam, also prophesied about these people.[a] He said, “Look! The Lord came with countless thousands of his holy ones.”[b][c]

public_domain_references.bsb: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about them: “Behold, the Lord is coming with myriads of His holy ones
public_domain_references.web: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
public_domain_references.asv: And to these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
public_domain_references.kjv: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,

pob.text: to execute judgment against all and to convict all the ungodly concerning all their ungodly deeds that they committed in ungodliness[c][b][a], and concerning all the harsh things that ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

spob.text: to carry out judgment against everyone and prove all ungodly people guilty of every ungodly deed they committed in their ungodliness, and of every harsh word that ungodly sinners spoke against him.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: to execute judgment on everyone, and to convict all the ungodly of every ungodly act of wickedness and every harsh word spoken against Him by ungodly sinners.”
public_domain_references.web: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
public_domain_references.asv: to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have ungodly wrought, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
public_domain_references.kjv: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard [speeches] which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

pob.text: These are grumblers[a], malcontents, walking according to their own desires, and their mouth speaks arrogant things[c][b], showing favoritism for the sake of gain.

spob.text: These people grumble and complain about their lot. They live by their own desires, speak arrogant words, and show favoritism to gain something for themselves.

public_domain_references.bsb: These men are discontented grumblers, following after their own lusts; their mouths spew arrogance; they flatter others for their own advantage.
public_domain_references.web: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
public_domain_references.asv: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their lusts (and their mouth speaketh great swelling [words]), showing respect of persons for the sake of advantage.
public_domain_references.kjv: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling [words], having men’s persons in admiration because of advantage.

pob.text: But you[a], beloved, remember the words spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

spob.text: But you, dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus the Messiah told you earlier.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: But you, beloved, remember what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ
public_domain_references.web: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.asv: But ye, beloved, remember ye the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
public_domain_references.kjv: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

pob.text: that they were saying to you[a], “In the last time there will be mockers[b], going according to their own ungodly desires.”

spob.text: They kept telling you, “In the last time,[a] there will be mockers who follow their own ungodly desires.”

public_domain_references.bsb: when they said to you, “In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow after their own ungodly desires.”
public_domain_references.web: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
public_domain_references.asv: that they said to you, In the last time there shall be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.
public_domain_references.kjv: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.

pob.text: These are the ones who cause divisions[a], worldly people[c][b], not having the Spirit.

spob.text: These people cause divisions.[a] They live by merely human impulses and do not have the Spirit.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: These are the ones who cause divisions, who are worldly and devoid of the Spirit.
public_domain_references.web: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
public_domain_references.asv: These are they who make separations, sensual, having not the Spirit.
public_domain_references.kjv: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.

pob.text: But you[a], beloved, building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit[c][b],

spob.text: But you, beloved, as you build yourselves up in your most holy faith[a] and pray in the Holy Spirit[b],

public_domain_references.bsb: But you, beloved, by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,
public_domain_references.web: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
public_domain_references.asv: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,
public_domain_references.kjv: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,

pob.text: keep yourselves in the love of God[c][b][a], waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus the Messiah unto eternal life.

spob.text: Stay in the love of God[a] as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus the Messiah—the mercy that leads to eternal life.

public_domain_references.bsb: keep yourselves in the love of God as you await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
public_domain_references.web: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
public_domain_references.asv: keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
public_domain_references.kjv: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

pob.text: And have mercy on those who are doubting,[a]

spob.text: And show mercy to those who have doubts.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And indeed, have mercy on those who doubt;
public_domain_references.web: On some have compassion, making a distinction,
public_domain_references.asv: And on some have mercy, who are in doubt;
public_domain_references.kjv: And of some have compassion, making a difference:

pob.text: save others by snatching them out of the fire[a]; and have mercy on others with fear[d][c][b], hating even the tunic stained by the flesh.

spob.text: Save others by snatching them from the fire.[a] Show mercy to others with fear,[b] while hating even the garment stained by the flesh.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: save others by snatching them from the fire; and to still others show mercy tempered with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
public_domain_references.web: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
public_domain_references.asv: and some save, snatching them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
public_domain_references.kjv: And others save with fear, pulling [them] out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

pob.text: To the one who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you blameless before his glory with rejoicing[c][b][a],

spob.text: To the one who can keep you from stumbling and present you blameless before his glory with rejoicing,[a][b]

pob.text: to the only God our Savior[a], through Jesus the Messiah our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority, before all time and now and forever[b]. Amen.

spob.text: Through Jesus the Messiah, our Lord, may the only God, our Savior, receive glory, majesty, ruling power, and authority—before all time, now, and forever. Amen.

public_domain_references.bsb: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
public_domain_references.web: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
public_domain_references.asv: to the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, [be] glory, majesty, dominion and power, before all time, and now, and for evermore. Amen.
public_domain_references.kjv: To the only wise God our Saviour, [be] glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
